maddeler.e:
قللت (form I)
# قَلَلْتُ (qalaltu) /qa.lal.tu/: first-person singular past active of قَلَّ (qalla)
# قَلَلْتَ (qalalta) /qa.lal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of قَلَّ (qalla)
# قَلَلْتِ (qalalti) /qa.lal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of قَلَّ (qalla)
# قُلِلْتُ (quliltu) /qu.lil.tu/: first-person singular past passive of قَلَّ (qalla)
# قُلِلْتَ (qulilta) /qu
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
